そう答えると思ったよ。{1a}ありがとう、{10}・・・

strings.jp:

いい策が思い浮かばないよ。{1a}僕達のゲリラ{e09b}戦を嫌い
平原に陣地を構えた彼らが
この平原を動くことはないだろう。{1a}しかも、この平原を押さえるだけで、
ルイトガルド{e09d}{e09e}の{e09f}と{e0a0}糧は
尽きてしまうのだから。{1a}{e0a3}の森は切り{e0a5}かれ
後ろからの奇襲{e09b}戦も出来ない・・・{1a}くそっ、これでは戦力の差が
強調されるばかりだ。{0c:fe}
strings.read:
{1c:13}だが、どうすればよいのか・・・

strings.en:
{1c:13}But what are we to do... Think as I might,
this time no good plan comes to me.{1a}They hate our guerrilla tactics and have
made camp on the plain, and they won't
budge from it.{1a}What's more, holding this plain is enough
by itself to run Luitgard's lands out of
water and food.{1a}The southern forest has been cleared,
so we can't surprise them from
behind either...{1a}Damn it, this only makes the gap in
strength stand out.{0c:fe}
strings.tl: But what are we to do... Think as I might, this time no good plan comes to me. // They hate our guerrilla tactics and have made camp on the plain, and they won't budge from it. // What's more, holding this plain is enough by itself to run Luitgard's lands out of water and food. // The southern forest has been cleared, so we can't surprise them from behind either... // Damn it, this only makes the gap in strength stand out.

戦士も{e0ac}人いると聞いた・・・{1a}だとすれば、
僕達の得手不得手を知っている
人間がいても不思{e0ad}じゃない。{1a}今までと同じようには
いかせてくれないだろう。{1a}相手が13の{e093}の寄せ集めで
{e0ae}携の悪い{e0b0}が唯一の救いだけど、{1a}僕の父に対する彼らの恨みが

strings.en:
{1c:15}What's more, I hear they've hired a
mercenary band that wields powerful
Magic Tools.{1a}Among them, they say, are several
fighters from Kars Bastide...{1a}In that case, it wouldn't be strange if
someone there knows our strengths
and weaknesses.{1a}They won't let things go the way they
have so far.{1a}Our one saving grace is that they're a
patchwork of thirteen nations,
poorly coordinated,{1a}but I can't deny that their grudge
against my father fires their will
to fight...{1a}And my own men must still resent my
father too. Nothing but bad signs. And
so few moves left to us...{0c:fe}

Nothing but bad signs. And so few moves left to us...
